issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit test ships with the new mention, validation, or truncation behavior.
Integer config values are rejected by the is_string guard though the task says an integer snowflake may be accepted.
No CHANGELOG.md Unreleased entry for the new setting.
Unrelated removal of the PHP_CLI_SERVER_WORKERS comment line.

conventions.evidence: config/services.php:71 `mention_id => env('DISCORD_MENTION_ID')` matches sibling style; docs updated in .env.example:18, docs/ops/devops.md:84, docs/ops/logging.md:96; but no test despite TDD `No production code without a test` and no CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry

readability.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:31-60 small focused getMentionId/formatContent with clear names and consistent style

requirements.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:31-39 mention `<@id>` on own line with reserved truncation to 1800; app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:52-57 ctype_digit + 17-20 rejects @everyone/@here/abc/123/embedded newlines; but app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:49 `if (!is_string($id)) return null` rejects integer snowflakes the task says may be accepted

scope.evidence: everything serves the task except .env.example:9 removal of `# PHP_CLI_SERVER_WORKERS=4` plus blank line

security.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:52-57 ctype_digit + strlen 17-20 blocks @everyone/@here/newline/extra-char injection; non-string and empty return null safely

simplicity.evidence: lean getMentionId plus 10-line formatContent branch reusing MaxContentLength; only extra is defensive `if ($allowedContentLength < 0)` guard

tests.evidence: change.diff adds no tests/* file; mention, invalid-id, null/empty, and truncation-survives paths are uncovered

review.summary: Adds DISCORD_MENTION_ID plumbing with strict snowflake validation and truncation-safe mention. Missing tests and the integer-ID edge plus an unrelated .env.example cleanup mean it needs changes before merging.
